info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Management API provides capabilities for updating the details of specific external agencies within the correspondent bank directory. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can manage their relationships with external agencies efficiently, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and financial service providers looking to maintain their counterparties. This API facilitates operations to modify critical data related to external agencies, streamlining the overall banking process.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific correspondent bank entry in the agency's directory. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request body to successfully modify the entry.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the correspondent bank information for the specified resource. It should include all necessary fields and values that need to be modified.
